title: Aggregate catch and effort by assessment region — catcheffort_byregion
text: Grid cells assigned regions using centre point. cell size taken smallest gap unique latd values, coordinate shifted half gap (lond/latd assumed south-west corner cell, resolution assumed longitude). centres sit away cell edges, cells lost region boundary lies grid line (example, 150°). Region boundaries cut middle cell assign whichever region contains centre. Cells matched sf::st_within(), cell centre falling exactly region boundary, outside every region, dropped. VESS_N summed across cells, vessels operating one cell counted . Treat vessel-cell counts rather unique vessels.

title: Plot aggregated catch as scatterpies on a Pacific basemap — plot_aggregated_catch
text: aggregated_data data frame catch data , minimum, latd, lond sum_catch_mt columns. colour_by <data-masked> Column used fill split pie wedges (e.g. species code). Set NULL omit colour splitting plot single-colour pies. facet_by <data-masked> Optional column facet plot (e.g. year, gear type). Defaults NULL (faceting). pie_radius Numeric scalar; multiplier applied pie legend circle radii. Defaults 1. alpha Numeric scalar; fill transparency pie wedges. "wcpo_epo" Western-Central Pacific Ocean Eastern Pacific Ocean split, separated 150°W meridian. "npo_spo" North Pacific Ocean South Pacific Ocean split, separated equator. "nx_sx" Northern Southern regions within WCPFC Convention Area, separated equator west WCPFC boundary. "wcpfc_epo" Overlay WCPFC Convention Area WCPO/EPO split. Colours can customised using colour1 colour2. colour1 Colour used first region map types support colour customisation. Defaults "red". colour2 Colour used second region map types support colour customisation. Defaults "blue". shading Logical. TRUE, shade region(s) relevant type. plot type shares one colour across multiple sub-regions (e.g. "nx_sx"), union shaded single area. alpha Shading transparency. Defaults 0.2. ... optional arguments passed plot_pacific function
